book_1.title: Introduction to Remote Sensing
book_1.author: Arthur P. Cracknell
book_1.description: Addressing the need for updated information in remote sensing, this book provides a full and authoritative introduction for scientists who need to know the scope, potential, and limitations in the field.

book_2.title: Remote Sensing: Principles and Applications
book_2.author: B C Panda
book_2.description: Comprehensive coverage of remote sensing principles and their practical applications across various domains.

book_3.title: Introduction to Geospatial Technologies
book_3.author: Bradley A. Shellito
book_3.description: Combining both theoretical coverage and hands-on lab work, accessible to majors and non-majors alike, with lab activities utilizing both widely available freeware and ArcGIS.

book_4.title: Remote Sensing and GIS
book_4.author: Basudeb Bhatta
book_4.description: Provides exhaustive coverage of optical, thermal, and microwave remote sensing, global navigation satellite systems, digital photogrammetry, and visual image analysis.

book_5.title: Physical Fundamentals of Remote Sensing
book_5.author: E. Schanda
book_5.description: Comprehensive coverage of the theoretical foundations of remote sensing, including electromagnetic radiation interaction with natural objects.

book_6.title: Introductory Digital Image Processing
book_6.author: John R. Jensen
book_6.description: Focuses on digital image processing of aircraft- and satellite-derived, remotely sensed data for Earth resource management applications.

book_7.title: Remote Sensing Digital Image Analysis: An Introduction
book_7.author: John A. Richards
book_7.description: Provides an introduction to quantitative evaluation of satellite- and aircraft-derived remotely retrieved data.

book_8.title: Introduction to Microwave Remote Sensing
book_8.author: Iain H. Woodhouse
book_8.description: Extensive overview of microwave remote sensing technology for technically oriented undergraduates and graduate students.

book_9.title: Remote Sensing of Coastal Environments
book_9.author: Yeqiao Wang
book_9.description: Systematic treatment of key developments in coastal remote sensing, bringing together renowned scholars for comprehensive coverage.

book_10.title: Urban Remote Sensing
book_10.author: Qihao Weng, Dale Quattrochi, Paolo Gamba
book_10.description: Assembles professional experts to provide updates on applications of remote sensing technology to urban and suburban areas.

book_11.title: Hyperspectral Remote Sensing: Principles and Applications
book_11.author: Marcus Borengasser, William S. Hungate, Russell Watkins
book_11.description: Presents fundamentals of remote sensing at an introductory level, exploring all major aspects of hyperspectral image acquisition, exploitation, interpretation, and applications.

book_12.title: Advanced Remote Sensing: Terrestrial Information Extraction and Applications
book_12.author: Shunlin Liang, Xiaowen Li, Jindi Wang
book_12.description: Application-based reference providing mathematical concepts necessary for remote sensing data gathering and assimilation.

book_13.title: InSAR Imaging of Aleutian Volcanoes: Monitoring a Volcanic Arc from Space
book_13.author: Zhong Lu, Daniel Dzurisin
book_13.description: Provides theoretical framework for InSAR observations and capabilities, discussing state-of-the-art InSAR analysis techniques.

book_14.title: Bistatic Radar Polarimetry - Theory & Principles
book_14.author: Zbigniew H. Czyz
book_14.description: Comprehensive coverage of bistatic radar polarimetry theory and principles with practical applications.

book_15.title: Spotlight Synthetic Aperture Radar: Signal Processing Algorithms
book_15.author: Walter C Carrara
book_15.description: Presents SAR concepts and signal processing techniques unique to spotlight mode and the polar format algorithm.

book_16.title: A New Target Detector Based on Geometrical Perturbation Filters for Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture Radar (POL-SAR)
book_16.author: Armando Marino
book_16.description: Presents groundbreaking methodology for the radar international community, introducing perturbation analysis for target detection.

book_17.title: Radar Interferometry. Data Interpretation and Error Analysis
book_17.author: Ramon F. Hanssen
book_17.description: Comprehensive guide to radar interferometry principles, data analysis, and interpretation for deformation monitoring.

book_18.title: Radar Polarimetry for Geoscience Applications
book_18.author: Fawwaz T. Ulaby
book_18.description: Offers consolidated reference on radar polarimetry design, analysis, and application for geoscience applications.

book_19.title: Processing of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Images
book_19.author: Henri Maitre
book_19.description: Presents tools required for digital processing of synthetic aperture radar images for environmental monitoring and Earth resource mapping.

book_20.title: Synthetic Aperture Radar Polarimetry
book_20.author: Jakob J. Van Zyl
book_20.description: Describes application of polarimetric synthetic aperture radar to Earth remote sensing based on research at NASA JPL.

book_21.title: Introduction to Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Polarimetry
book_21.author: Wolfgang-Martin Boerner
book_21.description: Comprehensive overview of basic principles of radar polarimetry with fundamental field equations and electrodynamic foundations.

book_22.title: Polarimetric Radar Imaging: From Basics to Applications
book_22.author: Jong-Sen Lee, Eric Pottier, Brian J. Thompson
book_22.description: Presents polarimetric radar imaging and processing techniques for developing remote sensing applications using PolSAR imaging radar.

book_23.title: Urban High-Resolution Remote Sensing: Algorithms and Modeling
book_23.author: Guoqing Zhou
book_23.description: Presents advanced image processing methods and algorithms for 3D urban modeling, orthophotomap generation, and feature extraction.

book_24.title: Satellite Remote Sensing for Archaeology
book_24.author: Sarah Parcak
book_24.description: First comprehensive overview of satellite remote sensing for archaeology and its application to ongoing archaeological fieldwork projects.

book_25.title: Microwave Radar and Radiometric Remote Sensing
book_25.author: Fawwaz T. Ulaby
book_25.description: Comprehensive guide to microwave radar and radiometric remote sensing principles and applications.

book_26.title: Radargrammetric Image Processing
book_26.author: Franz W. Leberl
book_26.description: Comprehensive guide to radargrammetric image processing techniques and applications.

book_27.title: Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
book_27.author: Michael Theodore Eismann
book_27.description: Holistic treatment capturing the multidisciplinary nature of hyperspectral remote sensing with physical principles and applications.

book_28.title: LiDAR Remote Sensing and Applications
book_28.author: Pinliang Dong, Qi Chen
book_28.description: Expertly joins LiDAR principles, data processing basics, applications, and hands-on practices in one comprehensive source.

book_29.title: Multi-sensor System Applications in the Everglades Ecosystem
book_29.author: Caiyun Zhang
book_29.description: Explores applicability of multiple remote sensors for restoration and conservation efforts in wetlands using various sensor types.

book_30.title: Global Urban Monitoring and Assessment through Earth Observation
book_30.author: Qihao Weng
book_30.description: Introduces international collaborative effort for global urban monitoring and assessment through Earth observation technologies.

book_31.title: Integrating Scale in Remote Sensing and GIS
book_31.author: Dale A. Quattrochi, Elizabeth Wentz, Nina Siu-Ngan Lam, Charles W. Emerson
book_31.description: Most comprehensive documentation of scientific and methodological advances in integrating scale and remote sensing data.

book_32.title: Infrared Thermal Imaging
book_32.author: Michael Vollmer
book_32.description: Richly illustrated hands-on guide for researchers, teachers and practitioners in infrared thermal imaging.

book_33.title: Handbook of Radar Scattering Statistics for Terrain
book_33.author: Fawwaz T. Ulaby
book_33.description: Comprehensive reference for radar scattering statistics and terrain analysis.

book_34.title: Insar Principles: Guidelines for Sar Interferometry Processing and Interpretation
book_34.author: European Space Research and Technology Centre
book_34.description: Guidelines for SAR interferometry processing and interpretation from ESA.

book_35.title: InSAR Observations of Ground Deformation: Application to the Cascades Volcanic Arc
book_35.author: Amy Laura Parker
book_35.description: Applies measurements of ground deformation from satellite radar for understanding volcanic and magmatic processes.

book_36.title: Microwave Scattering and Emission Models and their Applications
book_36.author: Adrian K. Fung
book_36.description: Intended for practitioners and applied researchers in remote sensing applications and graduate students in the field.

book_37.title: Remote Sensing and GIS for Ecologists: Using Open Source Software
book_37.author: Martin Wegmann, Benjamin Leutner, Stefan Dech
book_37.description: Book about how ecologists can integrate remote sensing and GIS in their daily work using open source software.

book_38.title: Introduction to the Physics And Techniques of Remote Sensing
book_38.author: Charles Elachi, Jakob J. Van Zyl
book_38.description: Essential science and engineering foundation needed to understand remote sensing and apply it in real-world situations.

book_39.title: Applied Spatial Data Analysis with R
book_39.author: Roger S. Bivand, Edzer Pebesma
book_39.description: Addresses needs of researchers and students using R to analyze spatial data across a range of disciplines and professions.

book_40.title: Photogrammetry, GIS & Remote Sensing
book_40.author: S S Manugula, Veeranna Bommakanti
book_40.description: Written for use in classrooms by both instructor and students and also for independent study in the coming decades.

book_41.title: Multi-purposeful Application of Geospatial Data
book_41.author: Rustam B. Rustamov, Sabina Hasanova, Mahfuza H. Zeynalova
book_41.description: Dedicated toward space technology application in Earth studies based on satellite information classification and interpretation.

book_42.title: Infrared Technology Fundamentals
book_42.author: Monroe Schlessinger
book_42.description: Provides basic understanding of physical background and engineering considerations required for design of IR systems.

book_43.title: Multispectral Image Analysis Using the Object-Oriented Paradigm
book_43.author: Kumar Navulur
book_43.description: Brings fresh new perspective to remote sensing, object-based image analysis as a paradigm shift from traditional pixel-based approach.

book_44.title: Hyperspectral Remote Sensing: Fundamentals and Practices
book_44.author: Ruiliang Pu
book_44.description: Presents complete solutions from concepts, fundamentals, and methods of acquisition of hyperspectral data to analyses and applications.

book_45.title: Remote Sensing of Impervious Surfaces
book_45.author: Qihao Weng
book_45.description: First to focus entirely on developing field of remote sensing of impervious surfaces with mapping, data extraction, and modeling techniques.

book_46.title: Advances in Environmental Remote Sensing: Sensors, Algorithms, and Applications
book_46.author: Qihao Weng
book_46.description: Compiles comprehensive review articles examining developments in concepts, methods, techniques, and applications in environmental remote sensing.

book_47.title: Big Data for Remote Sensing: Visualization, Analysis and Interpretation
book_47.author: Nilanjan Dey, Chintan Bhatt, Amira S. Ashour
book_47.description: Thoroughly covers remote sensing visualization and analysis techniques based on computational imaging and vision in Earth science.

book_48.title: Remote Sensing of Impervious Surfaces in Tropical and Subtropical Areas
book_48.author: Qingsheng Zhang, Hui Lin, Yuanzhi Zhang, Qihao Weng
book_48.description: Offers complete and thorough system for using optical and SAR remote sensing data for improving impervious surface estimation.

book_49.title: Remote Sensing for Sustainability
book_49.author: Qihao Weng
book_49.description: Introduces current state of art remote sensing knowledge integral for monitoring world's natural resources and environments.

book_50.title: Remote Sensing Image Analysis: Including the Spatial Domain
book_50.author: Steven M. de Jong, Freek D. van der Meer
book_50.description: Presents wide range of innovative and advanced image processing methods for including spatial information in remotely sensed images.

book_51.title: Remote Sensing in Hydrology and Water Management
book_51.author: Gert A. Schultz, Edwin T. Engman
book_51.description: Provides comprehensive information on possible applications of remote sensing data for hydrological monitoring and modeling.

book_52.title: Polarisation: Applications in Remote Sensing
book_52.author: Shane Cloude
book_52.description: Introduces topics of radar polarimetry and interferometry for space sciences applications.

book_53.title: Satellite Remote Sensing for Conservation Action: Case Studies from Aquatic and Terrestrial Ecosystems
book_53.author: Graeme M. Buchanan
book_53.description: Presents detailed examples of application of satellite remote sensing covering both aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems to conservation.

book_54.title: Remote Sensing of Global Croplands for Food Security
book_54.author: Prasad Thenkabail, John G. Lyon, Hugh Turral, Chandrashekhar Biradar
book_54.description: Provides comprehensive knowledge base in use of satellite sensor-based maps and statistics for developing strategies for croplands.

book_55.title: Remote Sensing of Protected Lands
book_55.author: Yeqiao Wang
book_55.description: First book of its kind showcasing state-of-art remote sensing applications for inventory and monitoring of protected areas.

book_56.title: Remote Sensing and GIS for Ecologists: Using Open Source Software
book_56.author: Martin Wegmann, Benjamin Leutner, Stefan Dech
book_56.description: Allows ecologists to get started with application of remote sensing and understand its potential and limitations.

book_57.title: Introduction to the Physics And Techniques of Remote Sensing
book_57.author: Charles Elachi, Jakob J. Van Zyl
book_57.description: Essential science and engineering foundation needed to understand remote sensing and apply it in real-world situations.

book_58.title: Applied Spatial Data Analysis with R
book_58.author: Roger S. Bivand, Edzer Pebesma
book_58.description: Addresses needs of researchers and students using R to analyze spatial data across range of disciplines and professions.

book_59.title: Photogrammetry, GIS & Remote Sensing
book_59.author: S S Manugula, Veeranna Bommakanti
book_59.description: Basic concepts of Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing & GIS all included in single book for undergraduate students.

book_60.title: Multi-purposeful Application of Geospatial Data
book_60.author: Rustam B. Rustamov, Sabina Hasanova, Mahfuza H. Zeynalova
book_60.description: Dedicated toward space technology application in Earth studies based on satellite information classification and interpretation.
